description: This file defines the EntityTypeInterface, a PHP interface for entity type metadata in Drupal, including constants, method signatures for entity properties, handlers, permissions, and other metadata.

classes.name: EntityTypeInterface
classes.description: Interface for defining entity type metadata and behavior in Drupal.

methods.name: getOriginalClass
methods.description: Get the original class name of the entity type.

methods.name: getDecoratedClasses
methods.description: Get all classes associated with this entity type.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Get entity key definitions (id, revision, bundle, etc.).

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Get a specific entity key by name.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Check if a specific entity key exists.

methods.name: isStaticallyCacheable
methods.description: Determine if entities should be statically cached.

methods.name: isRenderCacheable
methods.description: Determine if entity rendering should be cached.

methods.name: isPersistentlyCacheable
methods.description: Determine if persistent cache of field data is used.

methods.name: hasHandlerClass
methods.description: Check if a handler class exists for a given type.

methods.name: getHandlerClass
methods.description: Retrieve handler class for a given type.

methods.name: getHandlerClasses
methods.description: Get all handler classes for this entity type.

methods.name: getFormClass
methods.description: Get form class for a specific operation.

methods.name: setFormClass
methods.description: Set form class for a specific operation.

methods.name: hasFormClasses
methods.description: Check if entity type has any forms.

methods.name: hasRouteProviders
methods.description: Check if entity type has route providers.

methods.name: getRouteProviderClasses
methods.description: Get all route provider handler classes.

methods.name: hasListBuilderClass
methods.description: Check if list builder class exists.

methods.name: hasViewBuilderClass
methods.description: Check if view builder class exists.

methods.name: entityClassImplements
methods.description: Check if entity class implements a given interface.

methods.name: setHandlerClass
methods.description: Set handler class for a handler type.

methods.name: getLinkTemplates
methods.description: Get link templates using URI template syntax.

methods.name: getLinkTemplate
methods.description: Get link template for a specific key.

methods.name: hasLinkTemplate
methods.description: Check if link template exists for a key.

methods.name: setLinkTemplate
methods.description: Set a link template for a key.

methods.name: getBundleEntityType
methods.description: Get the entity type that provides bundles.

methods.name: getBundleOf
methods.description: Get the entity type ID that this entity provides bundles for.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Check if entity data is internal.

methods.name: showRevisionUi
methods.description: Check if revision UI should be shown.

methods.name: isRevisionable
methods.description: Check if entity has revision support.

methods.name: getBundleListCacheTags
methods.description: Get cache tags for a bundle.

methods.name: isCommonReferenceTarget
methods.description: Check if entity type is a common reference target.

methods.name: getBundleConfigDependency
methods.description: Get config dependency info for a bundle.
